job.title: Internal Sales Support UPS Specialist
job.description:
Internal Sales Support UPS Specialist

We are seeking a customer-focused and technically minded Internal Sales Support Specialist to join a growing team in Sydney, supporting the sales of Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems and critical power solutions.

In this role, you will be a key liaison between the sales team, customers, distributors, resellers, and internal departments.
You will provide technical advice, prepare accurate quotations, interpret customer specifications and tender requirements, and recommend suitable power protection solutions.
Working closely with the sales and operations teams, you will help manage sales opportunities from initial enquiry through to quotation, follow-up, and order completion, ensuring excellent customer service and contributing to overall sales performance.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Respond to technical enquiries from end users and disributers.
  • Prepare accurate quotations, technical proposals, product brochures, and specifications for UPS systems and associated power protection equipment.
  • Assist with UPS sizing, battery sizing, power conditioners, maintenance bypass switches, and UPS status indicator sizing.
  • Review customer specifications and tender documents to develop compliant and technically appropriate solutions.
  • Support the sales process from initial enquiry through to quotation, negotiation, follow-up, and order placement.
  • Participate in customer meetings, product presentations, and technical discussions to support sales opportunities.
  • Proactively follow up quotations and sales leads to maximise conversion rates and achieve sales targets.
  • Manage incoming phone calls and emails, ensuring timely and professional responses to customer enquiries.
  • Occasionally visit customer sites to assess technical requirements and prepare accurate, fit-for-purpose quotations.
  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM and other internal databases and systems.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports, analyse sales performance, and provide relevant insights to management.
  • Collaborate with sales, operations, and other departments to support business activities and resolve customer issues.
  • Assist with operational tasks and overflow work as required, providing support across the wider team.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience:

  • Previous experience in internal sales support, technical sales, or a similar customer-facing role within the UPS, electrical or power protection.
  • Experience preparing technical quotations, reviewing tenders, interpreting specifications, and recommending suitable products or solutions.
  • Understanding of UPS systems, battery configurations, power conditioning equipment, and associated accessories is highly desirable.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly to customers and colleagues.
  • Confidence in participating in technical meetings, product presentations, and customer discussions.
  • Excellent customer service and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple enquiries, prioritise competing deadlines, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and commercial awareness.
  • Experience preparing sales reports and analysing sales data.
  • A collaborative, proactive approach and willingness to occasionally attend customer sites when required.

On Offer

  • The opportunity to develop your technical and commercial expertise in the critical power and UPS industry.
  • A collaborative working environment with close interaction across sales, technical, and operations teams.
  • Opportunities to build long-term customer relationships and contribute directly to business growth.

If you are technically minded, customer-focused, and enjoy supporting sales through practical solutions and excellent service, we would like to hear from you.
Please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and suitability for the role.
Unforunately this role doesn't come with sponsorship, full working rights in Australia are essential.

job.title: Senior Commissoining Manager
job.description:
Commissioning Manager – Data Centres Melbourne

We are seeking an experienced Commissioning Manager to join a leading data centre operator in Melbourne, taking a key role in the successful delivery and commissioning of major hyperscale data centre projects.

This is an opportunity for an experienced commissioning manager who has a proven track record leading data centre commissioning projects from planning through to completion.

About the role

You will be responsible for leading commissioning activities across simultaneous data centre projects, working closely with project teams, contractors, consultants and client stakeholders to ensure systems are delivered, tested and commissioned to the required standards.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the full commissioning process from design review through to operational readiness
  • Develop and implement project specific commissioning plans, test procedures and documentation
  • Oversee multi level testing including FAT, SAT, IST and functional performance testing
  • Coordinate and lead multi disciplinary teams including contractors, vendors, consultants and ICAs.
  • Ensure compliance with project specifications industry standards (including ASHRAE), quality, safety and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify risks early, drive issue resolution and maintain clear reporting to stakeholders.
  • Deliver complete, accurate commissioning documentation and support smooth transition to operations.

About you:

  • Data centre project leadership commissioning experience essential
  • Strong technical knowledge of data centre MEP systems and integrated testing methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in high pressure environment, manage complex stakeholder environments and deliver programme and quality targets
  • Electrical, Mechanical or Building Services Engineering qualifications (or equivalent trade)

On offer:

  • Salary guide (dependent on experience) $220,000 – $240,000 + Super + Bonus
  • Major data centre client side opportunity
  • Significant pipeline of projects

If you are an experienced Data Centre Commissioning Manager looking for a client-side opportunity with real growth potential in Melbourne, please submit your resume for immediate consideration.

job.title: Regional Commercial Manager
job.description:
Regional Commercial Manager | Data Centers | Southeast Asia

Our client is a specialist contractor serving the data center market across Asia. They’re looking for a Regional Commercial Manager to oversee the commercial performance of multiple data center projects across Southeast Asia, taking responsibility for cost management, contracts and project profitability across the regional portfolio.

This role calls for someone with a strong grounding in quantity surveying and cost management, backed by substantial commercial and contracts experience. You’ll take responsibility for profitability across the regional portfolio, support project commercial teams, and lead negotiations on major contracts and commercial issues.

You’ll need to be comfortable challenging a cost forecast in detail, then stepping back to advise senior management on the region’s wider commercial position.

The Role
You’ll oversee the commercial lifecycle across multiple concurrent projects, from tender review and subcontract procurement through delivery to final account settlement. Working closely with pre-construction and project leadership, you’ll make sure each project has a sound commercial strategy and that risks are identified and addressed early.

A key part of the role will be setting clear standards for project teams, strengthening cost control, and giving senior management an accurate view of performance across the region.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Taking regional responsibility for project commercial performance, including margins, cash flow and financial exposure.
  • Leading and supporting QS and commercial teams across multiple projects, reviewing forecasts and challenging assumptions where needed.
  • Overseeing cost planning, CVR reporting and cost-to-complete forecasts, with clear reporting at both project and regional level.
  • Leading commercial and contractual reviews of tenders, main contracts and key subcontracts, ensuring obligations and risks are understood before commitments are made.
  • Setting procurement strategies and supporting negotiations with specialist subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Overseeing contract administration, including notices, variations, claims and extensions of time, through to final account agreement.
  • Acting as the senior commercial contact for clients and delivery partners, leading negotiations and resolving escalated commercial issues.
  • Working with pre-construction teams to test pricing assumptions and ensure bids reflect delivery requirements and contractual risk.
  • Improving commercial procedures and reporting consistency across Southeast Asia.

What You Bring

  • A strong QS and cost management foundation, with 12+ years of relevant construction experience and at least 5 years in a senior commercial management or leadership role.
  • A track record of overseeing the commercial performance of multiple major projects, ideally across Southeast Asia.
  • Significant experience in data centers, mission-critical construction or complex MEP projects, with a good understanding of technical fit-out and white space delivery.
  • Strong commercial and contracts experience, including contract negotiation, administration and the resolution of claims or disputes.
  • Detailed knowledge of cost control and forecasting, with the ability to interrogate project accounts and identify financial exposure early.
  • Experience leading QS or commercial teams and working confidently with senior client representatives and internal directors.
  • A degree in Quantity Surveying or a related discipline. MRICS or an equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
  • The judgement to balance commercial protection with practical project delivery, and the confidence to challenge decisions when profitability is at risk.

Contact me via email at ben@mcr.agency for more information.

job.title: Commissioning Engineer - Data Centre Projects
job.description:
Commissioning Engineer – Data Centres | Melbourne

Join one of the fastest-growing sectors in construction. We’re looking for an experienced Commissioning Engineer to deliver Data Centre projects across Melbourne.

  • Reviewing commissioning documentation.
  • Coordinating subcontractors, vendors, consultants and specialist commissioning agents.
  • Identifying and resolving defects and commissioning issues.
  • Managing testing schedules and ensuring commissioning milestones are achieved.
  • Supporting client witnessing, demonstrations and final handover.
  • Maintaining detailed commissioning records and documentation.

About you:

  • Experience commissioning technically complex building services (MEP) projects.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Mechanical or Electrical (or Trade qualified).
  • Experience with functional performance testing and integrated systems testing.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A methodical, detail-focused approach to testing and documentation.
  • Confidence to coordinate multiple contractors and stakeholders in a live construction environment.
  • Full working rights in Australia.

If you're a Commissioning Engineer looking to take your career into Data Centres and mission-critical construction, this is an opportunity to get involved in some of Melbourne's most exciting projects.
